name: @repo/repo-guards
description: Derived fitness tests over the repo ITSELF: the invariants that span workspaces and therefore belong to none of them — the package dependency DAG and its platform-purity rules, the guards' own tree walk held against pnpm's workspace globs, ws change-kind reachability, one total dispatch per domain vocabulary, one spelling per cross-cutting predicate, the staged install layout, the environment contract every turbo task that runs the app must pass through, CI against `pnpm verify`, and vendored-code provenance. Every assertion walks the real tree; the written-down lists are the DAG's declared edge table and the per-guard exception rows, and every one of those rows drains.
